div.div: زَجَرٌ (Az, O, K) and ↓ زَجْرٌ (IDrd, O, K) Large fish, (K,) [i. e.] a species of large fish, (IDrd, O,) with small scales: (TA:) IDrd says, thus called by the people of El-'Irák, but I do not think the appellation to be genuine Arabic: (O:) pl. زُجُورٌ. (O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
